shared_elements: figures shown in profile facing the same direction
a repeated row of similar figures forming a horizontal register
relief carving divided into an upper and lower zone
a band of repeated motifs across the top of the surface
justification: Both surfaces organise profile figures into a repeated horizontal row beneath an upper register, which is the only real correspondence, and it is a very generic compositional habit. The depicted content differs fundamentally: A shows schematic animals (quadrupeds, a long-necked bird, a boar, snake-like zigzags) with no human presence, while B shows a procession of helmeted, kilted human figures with raised arms and a further figure raised on a structure, rendered far more naturalistically with anatomical and costume detail.
